text:
Amanda: Heads-up — planning to enable autoscale_burst_v2 for a small canary. Need infra help to flip the flag at 21:00 UTC and watch the guardrails for 30m. quick scope: 5% traffic to redwood-cust-canary orgs.
Jay: Got it. Which guardrails should we enforce?
Amanda: max_concurrency=60, queue_ms=2500, metric gate cpu_pct>=70 (if breached -> pause rollout). Fallback: immediately disable burst and route to queued path.
Li: Add a second gate on p95 latency increase > 15% over baseline. If that hits, auto-rollback.
Ravi: Can you paste the exact flag payload so I can wire it into deploy script?
Amanda: sure — using the flag service JSON: 
```
feature_flag: autoscale_burst_v2
enabled: false
canary:
  percentage: 5
  orgs: ["redwood-cust-canary"]
guardrails:
  max_concurrency: 60
  queue_ms: 2500
  cpu_gate_pct: 70
  p95_latency_increase_pct: 15
```
Jay: I'll review the rollout script and the PR. ping me the branch.
Amanda: PR is at github.com/redwood/infra/compare/enable-burst-canary PR#4321 — need a quick review before flip.
Marco: I'll own post-flip watch. I'll monitor p95/p99 latency, CPU, and queue length. dashboard: /dashboards/infra/autoscale (watch group: infra-oncall).
Amanda: Also planning a smoke test: run 200 concurrent short-requests against canary orgs for 2m. Marco can you run that at +5m after flip?
Marco: yep.
Ravi: small ask — can we gate the canary by region? prefer us-west only for first 15m to limit blast radius.
Amanda: good call. will scope canary to us-west for 15m then expand to global 5% if stable.
Li: Reminder: add alerting rule to paging for infra-oncall if cpu>85 or p99_latency>800ms for 2 consecutive minutes.
infra-bot: flag-service: Received toggle request for autoscale_burst_v2. Pending scheduled change at 2024-11-08T21:00:00Z.
Jay: Quick code-review note: in rollout script please include a soft-fail path that rolls to previous flag state if the flag API returns 5xx.
Amanda: added that and included idempotency token.
Ravi: Rollback command for ops if needed: `/infra/flags set autoscale_burst_v2 false --scope canary --reason "rollback"` — added to runbook.
Marco: I'll start a lightweight synthetic load at +5m and post results here.
infra-bot: deploybot: scheduled job 8792 created to execute flag toggle at 2024-11-08T21:00:00Z.
Amanda: Thanks all — please ack when you've reviewed PR#4321 and the runbook. I'll only flip once we have 2 approvals + infra-bot schedule. :thumbsup:
Jay: Reviewed, left minor nits but ok to merge.
Li: Reviewed, approved.
Ravi: Reviewed + runbook ok.
Marco: Watching post-flip.
Amanda: flipping in ~10m. will post a short summary after 30m watch.
Marco: initial smoke run looks fine — p95 steady, CPU spike to 68% then normalized. posting chart link.
Amanda: thanks — will keep thread updated. :rocket:
